tool_description: Discover and load reusable owner-scoped GHOST Skills from the explicitly selected CLI or GENERAL domain.
Use query for SQLite tag filtering followed by description-vector retrieval. GHOST returns at most ten ACTIVE candidates from that domain.
After selecting relevant candidates, call the same tool with the same domain and exact skill_ids to load their complete SKILL.md instructions.
server_instruction: Set skill_domain to exactly CLI or GENERAL. CLI and GENERAL use the same retrieval mechanism but separate artifacts and Skill Memory.
For a CLI task, search and load CLI Skills before execution. Loaded CLI Skills guide the MCP CLI task directly.
If no include_tags or exclude_tags are supplied, all ACTIVE Skills are eligible.
If include_tags is non-empty, only Skills carrying at least one named tag are eligible. No catalog tag is implicit in include_tags; include every desired tag explicitly.
exclude_tags removes every Skill carrying any excluded tag after inclusion is applied. The same tag cannot appear in both filters.

Use only tags currently present in the authenticated owner Skill tag catalog. Call ghost_skill_tag_settings with action show when the current catalog is not already known; never invent or infer another tag.
For General Skill prompt context, search and load GENERAL Skills. The Prompt Builder attaches the selected complete Skill text to the larger prompt; the loader does not build or run the prompt.
The query stage searches only Skill Description vectors inside the selected domain. Candidate metadata is not executable guidance.
Select only relevant candidates. Never invent, alter, infer, or reuse a Skill ID that was not returned for this authenticated owner and selected domain.

If candidates are relevant, call ghost_skill_loader again with the same skill_domain and their exact skill_ids. Only complete SKILL.md content returned by that call is Skill guidance or prompt context.
If no candidate is relevant, continue without a Skill. Do not force a match and do not call the loading stage with an empty list.
When the user identifies a Skill by an exact known ID, load that exact ID from the stated domain. A title or name is not an exact ID.
Never search or load the other domain as a fallback.
The loader is read-only. It does not create, update, archive, delete, or lock Skills.

field_descriptions.skill_domain: Exact isolated Skill domain: CLI for CLI execution guidance, or GENERAL for context attached to a larger prompt.
field_descriptions.query: A concise semantic description of the capability needed. Retrieval compares it only with Skill Description vectors in the selected domain.
field_descriptions.skill_ids: One or more exact owner-scoped Skill IDs selected from candidates returned earlier for the same domain.
field_descriptions.include_tags: Optional controlled tag union applied before semantic retrieval. A Skill is eligible when it has at least one included tag.
field_descriptions.exclude_tags: Optional controlled tags removed before semantic retrieval. A Skill is rejected when it has any excluded tag.
